text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and improve the design. When tests are good, developers feel more confident about making changes, because they know the tests will catch mistakes. In short, testing is not just about finding bugs; it gives teams the confidence to build better software faster.
